Name: Remove Standard Undershirt
Author: sumaniBlack
Description:
[size=3]This mod will allow you to run around shirtless when you don't want to go fully nude. Removing the Shirt will replace the undershirt with arms in a configurable color. Sadly the way SV works isn't simply painting the shirts onto the arms, but apparently removing the upper arms first. So if you only remove the shirt and the shoulder pad-looking arms for the male farmer what you get is missing arms and floating hands. I made a few color options, so you can see if it matches with your farmer.

I didn't put as much effort into the female farmer, because if your going shirtless with the female farmer you really should have a nude mod. From the two I tried the back-breaking breasts hide the missing arms adequately. I will only consider adding arms for the female farmer if there is actual use for them.

This mod may or may not be compatible with other mods changing the farmer, it depends on if the core build of the farmer is changed.
[b]
But nothing in the mod matches with the skin color of my farmer!
[/b]I can add arms of your skin choice to the mod without much problem, but I need a screenshot of your farmer. Maximum zoom level and as much skin as possible to steal the colors for the arms (that are technically not arms but part of a shirt that looks like arms which is why it doesn't autoadapt to the skin color).

[b]Why should I use this over <insert nude mod here>?
[/b]As mentioned above it depends on what you want. If you don't want to go fully nude this is a mod for you. If you want your farmer to run around naked but your mod only removes the arms then you may want to add this into the mix. It only replaces the standard shirts, so it shouldn't interfere with other mods. Since any nude mod needs to remove the standard shirts this mod needs to be loaded after the nude mod or else the other mod will remove the arms from this one.

[b]There are weird pixles when moving sideways![/b]
I reallly hope this is an issue that I am having because I have some mod active that interferes, but when moving to the sides there are additional pixels in the last animation frame that I couldn't track down and it's driving me crazy. If you can tell me where they come from I'm willing to pay a bounty in the form of 1 (one) Content Patcher mod of your choice updated to SV 1.6, provided the original author agrees.[/size]

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[size=3]1.Download and extract this mod and the required mods.
2.Put the extracted Mods into the \Stardew Valley\mods\ folder.
3.Launch the game and enjoy.[/size]
